'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Garrett Larson DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:21WRPR2 Larson DS BHBM.txt |Download]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162117/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event.html Internet Archive]
